page_title: HEI 4-1 KOL | Heidenheim v FC Koln 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Tobias Welz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln). It's a free kick to Heidenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+3' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) will take the corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
90' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) is about to take a corner kick.
89' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
88' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) will deliver the corner kick.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jan-Niklas Beste as he is replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
87' Here is a change. Jan Schoppner is going off and Bernhard Raab gives the last tactical orders to Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
86' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

86' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Kevin Muller was alert and the score remains the same.
84' FC Koln force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
81' Damion Downs (1. FC Koln) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement. Heidenheim get a free kick.
80' Bernhard Raab has decided to make a change. Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) replaces Eren Dinkci.
78' 4 - 1 Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
77' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
76' FC Koln win a corner.
76' It will be a substitution. Florian Dietz (1. FC Koln) is ready to enter the pitch as Eric Martel walks off.
76' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
75' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Heidenheim are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
75' FC Koln get a corner.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from FC Koln comes to nothing. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.

74' A pass lands at the feet of Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
72' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends it out of play.

72' A neat pass is well received by Florian Pick (Heidenheim), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the top right corner. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.

69' A pass travels right across the box to Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Kevin Muller denies him with a decent save.
66' Kevin Sessa comes off the pitch to be replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
66' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and FC Koln players have a reason to celebrate!
66' Wait! Referee Tobias Welz has indicated he is going to review the FC Koln goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

64' 3 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Carstensen hands Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the top left corner. 3:1.

64' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Kevin Muller pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
64' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln. FC Koln have a corner.

63' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman makes the right call and FC Koln will have a corner.
63' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

62' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' A substitution has been made. Dominique Heintz is replaced by Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln).
60' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Kevin Muller is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
58' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes a short corner kick.

58' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Heidenheim will take a corner.
57' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
56' A player from FC Koln commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Heidenheim.
55' Substitution. Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) has come on for Jan Thielmann.
52' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.
51' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

50' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Kevin Muller keeps the ball out.

50' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Welz blows for a foul. FC Koln win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
49' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
48' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
47' A snap shot from distance by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul. Heidenheim have a free kick.
46' The game is over for Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln). Mark Uth comes on for the second half.
46' Timo Schultz has made a change at the break. Damion Downs has come on in place of Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln).
46' Referee Tobias Welz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' The resulting corner from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
44' Unlucky! A great strike from Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
43' It seemed like Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
42' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Heidenheim.
41' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
36' 3 - 0 Goal! Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 3:0.
36' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
34' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Heidenheim have a free kick.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
28' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
26' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner.

25' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out for a corner. FC Koln can continue in their attacking effort.
22' 2 - 0 Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marvin Schwabe with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
19' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln earn a free kick.
16' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Marvin Schwabe. He makes it 1:0.
16' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
14' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
13' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
12' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Muller, who smothers the ball.
10' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln are awarded the free kick.
8' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Welz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Heidenheim have a free kick.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
4' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) commits a rough foul. Tobias Welz stops the game and makes a call. There is a free kick near the sideline to Heidenheim.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! FC Koln will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
